title: Parking License Addendum — Requests, Waitlist Offers, Assignment and Vehicle Rules
content:
A Parking License is requested and assigned only while the lease is active.

## 1. Lease standing

1.1 The lease's status in the system records decides: a request is taken, and a space or permit is assigned, only while the lease is active.
1.2 A lease in default or with an eviction filed receives no new license and no assignment.

| Lease status | New request | Assignment |
|---|---|---|
| Active | taken | made |
| In default | not taken | not made |
| Eviction filed | not taken | not made |
| Any other status | not taken | not made |

## 2. Waitlist and offers

2.1 Requests are served in the product's waitlist order, per product — by waitlist date, the date the request was received.
2.2 When a space frees up it is offered to the earliest request. The offer stays open for the product's offer window in calendar days.
2.3 An offer not accepted in time passes to the next request, while the lapsed request keeps its place for the next space.
2.4 A waitlisted request may be withdrawn at any time without charge.

*Hypothetical illustration.* Requests A (waitlist date 3 May), B (9 May) and C (20 May) wait for the same product. A space frees up and is offered to A; A does not accept within the offer window, so the space is offered to B. A keeps its place ahead of B and C for the next space that frees up.

## 3. The vehicle

3.1 When the product requires registration, the vehicle must carry a current state registration in the name of a leaseholder or approved occupant.
3.2 The vehicle must fit the product's maximum vehicle length and clearance limit.
3.3 The vehicle must be a plug-in electric vehicle when the product's space may be licensed only for one.
3.4 The vehicle must be of standard size unless the product allows over-standard-size vehicles; motorcycles are allowed where the product allows motorcycles.
3.5 Each license registers the product's number of vehicles per license — one vehicle.

## 4. What the license gives

4.1 A numbered space only when the product assigns a numbered space; otherwise any open unreserved space.
4.2 Covered parking only when the product's space is covered.
4.3 Gate access only when the product issues gate access with the license.

## 5. On assignment

5.1 The product's activation fee posts.
5.2 The product's number of gate remotes issued at start are handed over.
5.3 The monthly fee is locked for the product's fee-hold months.
